metadata.body:
Add opt-in snapshot-only storage for CI queue data and PR dashboard state to reduce clone size without discarding historical CI measurements or delivery acknowledgements. Addresses #434.

After promoting snapshot-capable code to all dashboard writers and completing the documented paused-writer cutover, enable it with:

```sh
gh variable set DATA_BRANCH_SNAPSHOTS --body true --repo open-telemetry/shared-workflows
```

Each generated branch then retains one complete, parentless snapshot. Explicit push leases prevent stale workers from overwriting accepted updates, and snapshot generations prevent stale fetches from rolling state backward.

Activation defaults to disabled. The cutover procedure includes an external backup, tree verification, and recovery guidance. Existing clones do not shrink automatically, and other refs to old data can retain history.

Refresh schedules and the stalled-run watchdog remain unchanged.
metadata.title: Add snapshot-only storage for generated data branches
